Mohammed Shahabuddin [ b ] (born 10 December 1949) is a Bangladeshi jurist and civil servant who has served as the president of Bangladesh since 2023. [ 2 ] He elected unopposed in the 2023 presidential election as the nominee of the then ruling Awami League. Prior to his presidency, Shahabuddin served as a district and sessions judge and a commissioner of the Anti-Corruption Commission from 2011 to 2016. [ 3 ] He was involved in Awami League politics during his student years but never formally joined politics afterward. Prior to the fall of Sheikh Hasina , he publicly expressed support for the Awami League on various occasions. Following the resignation , his political position drew public discussion and criticism from members of several political parties, some of whom questioned his political neutrality while serving as president. [ 4 ] [ 5 ]
